scope: Concept artwork only for arena invasion enemies Waves 9–12

generator.provenance: Original AI-assisted concepts generated for this project using approved project artwork as direct inputs. No external commercial sprite pack imported. No separate third-party asset license or exclusive copyright asserted.

characters.action: One floating palm gesture with a concentrated blue-violet orb, drawn within the concept only.
characters.weapon: None; robe tails, hair silhouette and hands identify the design.

characters.palette: Aged ivory, rust bronze, dark iron, charcoal, faded teal, amber-orange accents.
characters.action: One raised heavy downward sword-strike pose with shield braced.
characters.weapon: Straight ring-pommel jian in anatomical right hand, shield in anatomical left hand.

characters.design: Broad hand-hewn Chinese stone guardian with huge fists, short solid legs, chipped taupe-gray/brown rocks, carved brow and cloud-scroll details, jade chest seal/eyes/cracks, moss and small vegetation on anatomical left shoulder.

approvalConcerns: Exact logical pixel density, integer-scaled outlines and six-player crowd readability are not verified by enlarged concept boards. Numbers 44/52/54/66 in some scale vignettes are illustrative proposals, not measured production pixels, canvas sizes, hitboxes or balance changes.

Small talisman ink strokes, armor rivets/cloud-scroll shapes, rock cracks and moss leaves vary between the master and enlarged views. Major silhouettes, colors, weapon hands and moss shoulder are consistent; decorative details require a production model lock after owner review.

The spirit has a deliberately dense blue-violet core for visibility. Its degree of translucency and contrast over arena grass still require approval and a later production-scale render. These opaque RGB concept boards do not demonstrate actual sprite alpha.
The golem is about 1.5 times the hero height and substantially wider. Approve this concept size before later testing its visual footprint in crowded combat.
Six presentation swatches are representative material colors, not exhaustive locked sprite palettes. Small glow/paper accent colors are also shown directly in the designs and feature details.
